name: Inline Block Embeds
tip: Hold Ctrl or Cmd and click the inline text to open the source block. A plain click shows the embed link so you can edit it.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Inline Block Embeds is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for trusting it with your notes.
